2609.08634.title: Suan: Rectifying Direct Preference Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
2609.08634.paper_summary: Integrating robust safety guardrails into Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for delivering helpful yet harmless responses. While proprietary systems exhibit reliable safety controls, their underlying methodologies and trade-offs remain largely undisclosed. Achieving comparable security in open-weight models remains a persistent challenge, as post-trained variants frequently suffer from over-refusal and degraded general quality. To overcome these drawbacks, we introduce Suan, a novel preference optimization algorithm. Unlike existing methods, we formulate the optimization objective directly at the gradient level, bypassing the standard variational derivation. As a result, we obtain more interpretable and robust training dynamics. Extensive evaluations across a diverse suite of competitive baselines and benchmarks demonstrate that Suan achieves superior safety alignment while fully preserving response utility.
2609.08634.paper_summary_zh: 將堅固的安全防護措施整合到大型語言模型（LLMs）中對於提供有幫助但無害的回應至關重要。雖然專有系統展現出可靠的安全控制，但其基本方法論和權衡仍然大部分未公開。在開放權重模型中實現可比擬的安全性仍然是一個持續的挑戰，因為後訓練變體經常遭遇過度拒絕和整體質量下降。為了克服這些缺點，我們引入了Suan，一種新穎的偏好優化算法。與現有方法不同，我們直接在梯度層面上制定優化目標，繞過了標準的變分推導。因此，我們獲得了更具可解釋性和穩健的訓練動態。對各種競爭基準和基準測試的廣泛評估顯示，Suan在完全保留回應效用的同時實現了更優越的安全對齊。
2609.08634.author: Oleksandr Cherednichenko et.al.
